interpretation: Anomalies represent statistical deviations from observed movement patterns. They do not indicate wrongdoing or suspicious behavior.
threshold_note: The contamination parameter controls the expected proportion of observations treated as anomalies. A value of 0.08 was used for this academic simulation.
false_positive_note: Without ground-truth anomaly labels, conventional false-positive and false-negative rates cannot be reliably calculated. Detected anomalies should therefore be interpreted as statistical signals.
